subject: Evidence export: per-user change-delta & sessionized admin logs
messages:
From: compliance-team@medicosys.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: audits@acrohealth.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: per-user delta and sessionized admin logs for SIG review

Hi Hannah,

We're preparing for a SIG assessment and our auditor has asked for a narrowly scoped export: per-user change deltas (admin actions by user id with before/after metadata) plus sessionized admin event bundles (session start/end + ordered events). They want a CSV for deltas and a compressed bundle for session traces covering 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-30.

Can you confirm feasibility, expected file formats, and an estimated delivery ETA? We also need retention metadata (how long these event types are kept) and any redaction options for PII.

Thanks —
Dana Monroe
Compliance Manager, MedicoSys
compliance-team@medicosys.com

Attachment: SIG_scope_requirements.pdf (pdf)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: compliance-team@medicosys.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: per-user delta and sessionized admin logs for SIG review

Hi Dana,

Thanks for the clear scope. We can produce both artifacts. High-level answers below and a proposed delivery cadence:

- Format:
  - Per-user delta: CSV (one row per action) with columns: timestamp, actor_user_id, actor_email (optional), action_type, target_resource, before_json (base64), after_json (base64), request_id, trace_id.
  - Sessionized bundles: ndjson files grouped by session_id, compressed into a zip (session metadata + ordered events).

- Retention metadata: admin-action events are kept 13 months by default; change-deltas (enriched snapshots) are retained 90 days in hot storage and archived for 13 months upon request.

- Redaction: PII fields in before/after can be schema-driven redacted (configurable to remove email/SSN/phone). We can provide two variants: redacted export and raw export (raw requires a signed NDA/approved DPA amendment).

- ETA: initial sample export (one-week slice) by 2026-12-18; full export (2026-10-01 to 2026-11-30) by 2026-12-20 EOD.

I'll loop Sean and Vanessa to handle the extraction plan and secure delivery.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Trust & Security (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai; vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Evidence export: per-user delta & sessionized admin logs

Hannah / Vanessa — quick ops note on extraction approach.

1) We'll run a time-bounded export job on the admin-event ledger with these steps: hash the actor_email if raw not approved (SHA256 + salt), generate per-action delta rows by replaying change stream, and assemble sessionized traces using session_id and request_id.

2) Expected sizes: ~1.8M rows for the two-month window; CSV ~420MB gzipped; ndjson session bundles ~1.6GB compressed.

3) Delivery: S3 presigned URL (restricted to MedicoSys CIDR) + manifest + SHA256 checksums + a signed certificate of custody. If they need direct SFTP instead we can provision short-lived credentials.

Can we get approval for raw export if they provide the DPA amendment? Otherwise we'll produce the redacted CSV and note the truncated fields.

- Sean
Principal Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: export_plan_steps.md (text)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
